segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Yeah, so Quicklane is good with the 42 seats and the February 1 start. They asked if we can keep the first-year total at $31,920 and invoice annually, net 30.

segments.speaker: Luis
segments.text: That lines up with the quote we talked about. Any pushback on the services package?

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: No, the $4,800 onboarding is fine. I dropped Mara in pricing a note after lunch, and when her okay shows up I'll send the order form over.

segments.speaker: Luis
segments.text: Okay. Procurement on their side still saying they can turn it fast?

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Their controller said same day if it lands before Thursday noon. Otherwise it rolls to next week because she's out Friday.

segments.speaker: Luis
segments.text: Got it. And the data addendum, are they using our standard one?

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Mostly. They had one sentence on breach notice, pretty minor. I put it back in front of Ben this morning, so once he gives me the language I'll reply to their counsel.

segments.speaker: Luis
segments.text: Makes sense. Just keep the close date realistic then. Is March expansion still part of the conversation?

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Yeah, they mentioned another 15 seats for the dispatch team after go-live, but they don't want it on this order. They're trying to keep this one clean for budget.

segments.speaker: Luis
segments.text: Fair. Send me the final numbers before it goes out, just so I'm not surprised if they call me.
